items.name: Front Brake Pad Set
items.oem_note: Always use Porsche Genuine or Porsche Classic brake pads for optimal performance
items.replacement_interval: Every 25,000-50,000 miles depending on driving style

items.name: PCCB Ceramic Composite Brake Rotor
items.note: Porsche Ceramic Composite Brakes must be serviced at authorized dealers only. Extremely long-lasting but expensive to replace.

items.name: Porsche Approved Engine Oil (0W-40)
items.note: Use only Porsche-approved oils meeting specification A40. Mobil 1 0W-40 is the factory fill.

items.name: Coolant/Antifreeze
items.note: Use only Porsche-approved coolant. Do not mix with other brands.

items.name: N-Rated Tires
items.description: Porsche-specific tires marked with N0, N1, N2, etc. on the sidewall
items.note: These tires are specifically developed and tested for Porsche vehicles. While non-N-rated tires can be used, Porsche recommends N-rated tires for optimal performance and handling.
items.price_range_usd: 250-600 per tire depending on size and model

items.name: 12V Auxiliary Battery
items.note: Porsche vehicles use AGM batteries. Registration/coding may be required after replacement.

ordering_info.where_to_order: Contact your local authorized Porsche dealer or visit the Porsche Tequipment online shop
ordering_info.oem_vs_aftermarket: Porsche strongly recommends using Genuine Porsche Parts to maintain vehicle warranty, performance, and safety standards. Aftermarket parts may void certain warranty coverage.
ordering_info.porsche_classic: For vehicles older than 10 years, Porsche Classic supplies over 60,000 genuine parts to keep classic Porsche models on the road.
